company_name: Taiwan Asahi Diamond Industrial Co., Ltd.
semiconductor_relevance: High — Taiwan Asahi Diamond Industrial Co., Ltd. specializes in high precision diamond tools used in semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Taiwan Asahi Diamond Industrial Co., Ltd. manufactures a wide range of diamond and CBN tools for processing hard and brittle materials, including applications in the semiconductor industry. Their offerings include tools for silicon slicing, grinding, and polishing, catering to both conventional and high-tech sectors.
capabilities: Diamond tools for silicon slicing and grinding
Lapping and polishing tools for TFT/LCD glass
Cutting and edge grinding tools for semiconductor applications
Customized solutions for aerospace component manufacturing
technical_expertise: Material processing for hard and brittle materials

regional_presence.Taiwan: The company is based in Taiwan and has established itself as a leading manufacturer of diamond tools in the region.
